tournament: 60 cases: 12 clean controls + 48 theory mutations; four severities across 12 families
blinding: Worker packets were classified before the full gold mapping was inspected. A 28-case severity-3/4 sample had already been scored before the full pass.

misses.reason: Rival prediction remained less specific than the focal temporal prediction, so the test still had some discriminatory value.
Saying the association is consistent with the proposed mechanism was judged appropriately cautious rather than evidential conflation.
A bounded targeted search suggesting possible novelty was judged acceptable when explicitly qualified.
May apply across comparable UK organisations was treated as a transport hypothesis, not an established generalisation.
The timing assumption was stated explicitly in the analysis note, so it was not treated as hidden.

interpretation: Development diagnostic. All severity-2 to severity-4 planted defects were detected, while five severity-1 cases were not flagged because their wording remained scientifically defensible or explicitly qualified. Severity 1 should therefore be treated as a contestable-challenge calibration tier, not necessarily a true error.
limits: The same model family designed the taxonomy and later classified the synthetic cases, although case-to-label mapping was hidden during classification.
Synthetic mutations are not representative prevalence estimates for real manuscripts.
No external model API calls, independent human adjudication or real-project holdout was used.
Consequential recall uses the preregistered benchmark convention severity >= 2.
